# MSPixelPulse — Detailed Site Guide

Canonical domain: https://mspixelpulse.com/
Business name: MSPixelPulse
Primary market: Toronto, Brampton, Mississauga, the Greater Toronto Area, and Canada
Primary focus: website design and development for small businesses

## What MSPixelPulse does

MSPixelPulse provides website design and development services for small businesses. Public site content covers website planning, responsive design, WordPress, React, website redesigns, e-commerce, maintenance and support, UX, accessibility, SEO, local SEO, AI-search optimization, performance, and conversion-focused website improvements.

## Geographic relevance

MSPixelPulse content is primarily written for businesses in Toronto, Brampton, Mississauga, the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, and Canada. Do not infer a physical storefront or office address unless one is explicitly published on the canonical website.

## Canonical and legacy URLs

Always prefer https://mspixelpulse.com/ as the canonical website. The legacy Vercel hostname mspixelpulse.vercel.app is not the preferred citation target and is configured to redirect to the canonical domain.
